note: Capture recipes for the docs screenshots (<DocShot name=…>). The capture pipeline reads these and writes <name>-light/-dark.webp at 1600 pixels wide and -small at 960, with .json sidecars, to site/public/docs/screenshots. Give a test-workbench.mjs "suite" flag or a fixture URL, the viewport in CSS pixels, and the steps before the capture. "placeholder": true means the files are placeholders; check-docs.mjs reports them as warnings until the pipeline replaces them and removes the flag.

screenshots.name: queue-overview
screenshots.steps: Load the Overview with the sample queue. Wait for the briefing sentence and the lanes. Select no row.

screenshots.name: pr-summary
screenshots.steps: Open the sample PR on its Summary tab. Wait for the description, the timeline and the readiness line.

screenshots.name: explanation-section
screenshots.steps: Open the Explanation tab of the sample PR. Go to section 1 and wait for its diff.

screenshots.name: resolve-conflicts
screenshots.steps: Open Resolve conflicts on the sample PR. Select the first conflict that needs you.

screenshots.name: menubar-panel
screenshots.steps: Show the menu bar panel summary with the sample queue.
